replies.mention_invalid:
❌ Invalid mention format: `{mention}`

Supported formats:
• `@everyone` or `everyone`
• `@here` or `here`
• `<@&ROLE_ID>` (role mention)
• `<@USER_ID>` (user mention)

Tip: to mention a role, type `@rolename` in Discord then copy the result.
